§ 01 · The Program

A complete
curriculum.

Every passage is written for true B1 intermediate learners — richer, longer texts spanning society and everyday life, business and work, travel and culture, technology and innovation, and personal development. Each one is paired with eight carefully written comprehension questions, moving learners confidently across the threshold from elementary to genuine intermediate fluency. Built for use inside classrooms, self-study programs, and intermediate English courses.

APPROACH

Authentic content

Every passage reflects real, natural B1-level English drawn from genuinely contemporary topics and ideas.

ENGAGE

CEFR-aligned

Structured for true B1 comprehension — longer texts, richer vocabulary, and more nuanced argument than A2.

REFLECT

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with a clear answer key showing exactly which choice was correct and why.

CROSS

Progress tracking

Your completed passages and scores are saved automatically, so you can revisit and improve over time.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Reading Comprehension Expert

Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for learners at every level. Threshold takes its name from the official CEFR description of B1 — the level at which learners genuinely cross from elementary understanding into independent, intermediate command of English.

Designed for B1 learners ready for richer, more substantial texts — Threshold is more than exercises. It's the doorway to independent reading: the point where learners stop translating and start simply understanding.
